purpose: Design for extracting formal references, checking them against scanned files, notifying change-impact candidates, and running consistency checks with detail files.
summary: Formal references are extracted from reference-link definitions whose title ends with a DLID, with an optional recorded content hash
Directory scan classifies each reference as match, path mismatch, or absent, and checks fragments against anchors
Moved documents are located via the DLID-to-path map built from the current Index target list
Links without a DLID in the title get a suggested title value computed from the current file contents
Reverse references are built from scanned sources and limited to documents and sections in the confirmed ToC
Impact candidates are references whose recorded content hash differs from, or is missing against, the current hash
Change-impact notification returns facts to the project management AI; doc-link holds no notification state and edits nothing
Consistency checks are split into check-dlid, check-links, check-toc, and check-impact skills
Checks print counts to stdout and write full details to a detail JSON file under .temp, returning its absolute path
Missing-section detection rule and the write boundary that checks never modify Index target documents
tasks: Implementing or modifying check-links reference checking
Implementing check output as counts plus detail files
Reviewing reference and hash comparison rules
Writing the title value suggestion for links without a DLID
